title: Common juniper
def: Common juniper is a low, spreading evergreen shrub with sharp needles in threes and blue berry-like cones.
look: low spreading evergreen shrub with sharp needles in threes and blue berry-like cones

use: Knowing the tree helps you pick firewood, shelter sites, and landmarks. Do not mix it up with yew, which is deadly.
not: Do not eat or brew any part of a tree you have not identified in person; some trees, like yew and wilted cherry leaves, are deadly.

title: Yew (Canada yew)
def: Canada yew is a low evergreen shrub with flat needles and red fleshy berries whose seeds, needles, and bark are deadly.

low shrub
red cup-shaped berry with a dark seed showing
use: Knowing the tree helps you pick firewood, shelter sites, and landmarks. Needles, seeds and bark are deadly.
not: Never eat or brew any part of it; it is deadly, and children are drawn to the red berries.
